notes.title: Patch Notes ver1.0.3.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "The Mightiest Sword is Mine!"

In this patch, we have added an Auto Forge feature, adjusted some skills, and fixed several bugs. The skill adjustments mainly focus on maintaining or enhancing effects at lower levels, while gradually decreasing efficiency at higher levels. We apologize for the frustration caused by the previous version's insufficient scaling adjustments and the subsequent patches.

Our aim is not "the higher the level, the better the efficiency and scaling," but rather "the higher the level, the lower the efficiency, while still allowing for growth." While the former approach may be more exhilarating, we had to opt for the latter to maintain game balance and prevent numerical overflow. We appreciate your understanding.

Details of this patch are as follows:

System Additions

Added the Auto Forge feature.


Adjustments

Adjusted the effects of the skills "Diligence Proof," "Polishing Forging," and "Time Distortion: Polishing." These skills now increase in strength when a specific value is reached, similar to the "Symbiosis" skill.


Fixes

Fixed an issue where clicking during operations in the AllForge window would inadvertently trigger attacks.
Corrected text that was improperly displayed in some instances.
Fixed certain behaviors when opening specific windows.
Corrected the text in the skill description window for "Symbiosis."


In the unfortunate event that your save data becomes corrupted, we regret to inform you that we are unable to provide support. Please use the backup feature to safeguard your progress.
For reference, please visit: https://mihibiki.com/?page_id=350

As a game developer, I still have much to learn and improve upon. I appreciate your continued support.

Rufa

notes.title: Patch Notes ver1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing The Mightiest Sword is Mine! In this patch, we've made some adjustments to certain systems and skills, as well as fixed some bugs. Please see the details below.

Adjustments

Revised the Gem acquisition formula. The amount of Gems obtained has increased, and it is now more smoothly aligned with the ATK value.
Along with the adjustment to the Gem acquisition formula, the skill effect of "Magic Light" has been adjusted. Efficiency is improved before level 41, but decreases thereafter.
Adjusted the skills "Diligence Proof," "Polishing Forging," and "Time Distortion: Polishing." The efficiency of early-stage scaling has been improved (the effect at level 11 has been doubled), while the efficiency of late-stage scaling has been reduced (from around level 138, the scaling efficiency decreases compared to before).
Modified the behavior of the recommended button to prioritize stages where all enhancements have not yet been completed.


Fixes

Updated some text in line with the adjustments to the Gem acquisition formula.
Fixed a bug where the game would malfunction if an overflow occurred in the calculation for achievements requiring a certain level of maximum damage.
Changed the data type for some items.
Modified the process for obtaining materials.


We are currently working on features like auto-enhancement and automatic stage progression to make your adventure even smoother. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Patch Notes Ver 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing The Mightiest Sword is Mine!
This patch introduces new systems and fixes some issues. Please see the details below.

New Systems

Added "All Forge," which allows for enhancement by consuming all materials.


Adjustments

Set the maximum multiplier for the red forge button (when enhancement count is a multiple of 10) to 10x.
Adjusted the formula for obtaining Clock Points during time rewind so that the increase is reduced when ATK exceeds 21 digits.
Modified the formula for gem acquisition during time rewind to reduce the increase when ATK exceeds 30 digits.


Fixes

Fixed incorrect English and Simplified Chinese translations in "Time Distortion."
Changed the data types of certain data.
Modified the display format of gem possession text.
Revised the notation for extremely large numbers.
Fixed an issue where overflow occurred in the calculation of the "Symbiosis" skill when dealing large damage at once, causing the game to malfunction.
Added a limit to the increase in font size when critical hits are duplicated.


We will continue to make adjustments and fixes as needed.
Thank you for your continued support!
